fieldNotes.siteResolution: Given city-level coords (49.1579,-121.9515) were ~4.6km NE of the true site. Web research + the supplied lead resolved the facility to 6388 Unsworth Rd, Chilliwack BC V2R 5M3 (Greendale, corner of Unsworth Rd & South Sumas Rd). This is a 225,270 sqft / 8.67-acre MULTI-TENANT industrial complex whose anchor is Nestle Canada; Triton Water Canada Holdings / Nestle Waters Canada occupies unit 527 here (per Canpages/Yellowpages/LoopNet/Western Investor). Co-tenants per the leasing record: Tycrop Mfg, Bullseye Packaging, Ice River Springs (unit 511), Old Yale Brewing (corner taproom, confirmed by Street View signage), plus shared truck parking. This is the DISTRIBUTION/WAREHOUSE address, not the BC bottling plant (which is in Hope at 66700 Othello Rd). Audited building = the addressed anchor warehouse fronting the Unsworth/South Sumas corner; center locked at 49.11795,-121.99110.
fieldNotes.truckGate: FALSE. No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or guard booth across any truck approach. 2023-06 Street View along South Sumas Rd and Unsworth Rd shows open landscaped driveways straight into the property, and a deeper pano (SW corner, pano W2B0feXmoivAMAdGDIzNXA) looks into a fully open paved yard between the buildings with trailers/containers and no checkpoint. A small chain-link enclosure mid-yard surrounds process silos/tanks (utility fencing), not a truck-control gate. Open multi-tenant industrial estate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE. No booth-sized staffed structure (1-3 vehicle footprint, multi-side windows) at any entrance in satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: FALSE because there is no truck gate at all (no gate => no remote/kiosk check-in implied).
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: 2 open vehicular access points serve the anchor lot: one off Unsworth Rd (west) and the internal-park road off South Sumas (north). Neither is controlled; counted as physical entrances.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Marked true (with low confidence) because two separate uncontrolled access points exist (Unsworth + internal road), so inbound and outbound traffic can use different points; not a formal in-gate/out-gate pairing.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Anchor building SOUTH face carries one continuous dock bank; counted ~18-22 doors with marked apron stalls and a few trailers backed in (z19/z20 crops p21-anchor-z19, p21-dockcenter-z20, p21-dockbank). Banded 10-25 (sits near the top of the band). The much larger neighbouring south warehouse on the estate adds another ~20+ west-face docks but is treated as a separate building/tenant.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop activity is in the shared internal yard south of the dock bank and along the south-building west face: ~12-16 parked trailers/containers visible (some without tractors). Banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE. The shared paved internal yard between the anchor and the south warehouse functions as a trailer/container drop and staging lot, distinct from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large open paved yard immediately south of the dock bank acts as an internal queue/staging area (no gate to be 'post', but a clear pre-dock holding apron).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep open yard from the street to the dock apron easily holds 3+ trucks queued; no pinch point.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: FALSE. Generous open yard and wide internal park roads; a truck queue would not spill onto a public road.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cannot confirm distinct ship vs receive banks for the anchor unit from imagery (single south-face dock bank). Marked false, low confidence.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad visible in the truck path. FALSE.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest is the CN/road corridor north of South Sumas. FALSE.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Greendale, an edge-of-town/agricultural-industrial pocket of Chilliwack in the Fraser Valley with farmland and the Cascade foothills adjacent (visible in Street View). Judged RURAL per the small-town tie-break rule.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: FALSE. Within a developed industrial estate on the edge of Chilliwack (pop ~90k); cellular coverage is adequate.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: TRUE. The 6388 Unsworth estate is a campus of multiple large building clusters (anchor warehouse + a very large adjacent south warehouse + a further east warehouse + lumber/3PL yards), shared among several tenants.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Counted 1 for the audited anchor warehouse unit (the addressed Nestle Waters/Triton DC building). The wider estate has 3+ large buildings, captured via multipleFacilities=true.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Measured ~4.3 acres for the operational anchor-building lot (building + dock apron + immediate yard + east parking) from the perimeter polygon. The documented parcel is 8.67 acres (225,270 sqft building); the extra acreage covers shared yard/the larger south warehouse footprint that belongs to the estate rather than the single audited unit. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~14 across the dock apron and shared yard in the captured imagery; mixed capture vintages, approximate.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Shared internal yard + drop lot could hold ~35-45 trailers; banded estimate ~40.
fieldNotes.imageryQuality: 2026 Airbus/Maxar satellite is sharp at z18-z20 (z21 returned no tile). Street View is 2023-06 on the public roads; the internal yard has no Street View coverage (private). Indoor 'Views4Business' panos exist for the Old Yale Brewing taproom (ignored).
fieldNotes.streetViewMeta: Perimeter pano _J9T-Be8_tQqdA4hW-uBXQ (49.11766,-121.99238 on Unsworth) heading 68 deg toward the building; truckGate pano W2B0feXmoivAMAdGDIzNXA (49.11791,-121.99214, SW yard mouth) heading 135 deg into the open yard. Both status OK.
